bilingualSummary.EN:
AI Labor Transition Monitor
Occupational data through: 2026-08
AI adoption: Observed business use: 23.8% (2026-09-06); expected use: 27.6% (six-month survey expectation); separate from occupational exposure
Nominal weekly earnings: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE (annual endpoint 2024)
Employment divergence: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE (annual endpoint 2024)
Usual hours: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE (annual endpoint 2024)
Young-worker composition: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE (annual endpoint 2024)
Methodology agreement: DESCRIPTIVELY_CONSISTENT
Change: NO_ECONOMIC_CHANGE
Source health: btos: CURRENT; ces: CURRENT; cps: PARTIAL; jolts: CURRENT
Matched coverage: academic: 37.8%; microsoft: 47.6%. Employment pretrend gaps: academic: +0.20 pp/year; microsoft: -1.18 pp/year.
Evidence limitations: partial coverage, pretrends, survey uncertainty, earnings comparability.
Causality: NOT ESTABLISHED. Not an AI unemployment forecast. Email delivery disabled.
bilingualSummary.ZH:
AI 劳动力转型观察
职业数据截至：2026-08
AI 使用：企业实际使用：23.8%（2026-09-06）；预计使用：27.6%（未来六个月调查预期）；不等同于职业暴露
名义周收入：证据不足（完整年度截至 2024）
就业差异：证据不足（完整年度截至 2024）
通常工时：证据不足（完整年度截至 2024）
年轻劳动者构成：证据不足（完整年度截至 2024）
方法一致性：DESCRIPTIVELY_CONSISTENT
本次变化：NO_ECONOMIC_CHANGE
数据健康：btos: CURRENT; ces: CURRENT; cps: PARTIAL; jolts: CURRENT
匹配覆盖：academic: 37.8%; microsoft: 47.6%。就业既有趋势差：academic: +0.20 pp/year; microsoft: -1.18 pp/year。
证据限制：覆盖不完整、既有趋势、调查不确定性及收入可比性。
因果关系：尚未确立。不是 AI 失业预测。邮件发送关闭。
